eligibility: be 18 years of age or older by Dec. 7, 2026
be available for a full-time internship (30 hours per week)
if you are a student, have 42 consecutive days free from school and exams during the internship
if you are a student on a visa, have a visa that allows you to work 30 hours per week
cannot_apply_if: You cannot apply if you are a past Outreachy intern
You cannot apply if you are a past Outreach Program for Women intern
You cannot apply if you are a past Google Summer of Code intern, even if you did not finish it
You cannot apply if you have another internship during the internship period, including unpaid ones
You cannot apply if you have a full-time job during the internship period. If you are willing to quit it, you can still apply
You cannot apply if you have a full-time contracting position during the internship period
You cannot apply if you are on a leave of absence from a full-time job during the internship period
You cannot apply if you are a student planning to take a school term off to do the internship
prepare: Write answers to the five essay questions first and keep them in a personal document. Answers are limited to 1000 characters
Do not use generative AI to write or edit the essays
Academic calendar for this year and future terms, if you are a university student
Calendar for your online courses or coding school cohort, if you take them
Employment contract, weekly hours, start and end dates, if you are employed
Average invoiced hours over the past six months, if you are self-employed
List your current internships and jobs on the initial application
The application cannot be saved. Fill it in one go with a stable internet connection
good_to_know: If you are not a student, you may apply to either round (May to August or December to March)
Students at universities in the northern hemisphere can only apply to the May to August round. Students in India count as northern hemisphere
Students at southern hemisphere universities can only apply to the December to March round. Near the equator it is decided case by case
If you are in your last term, you can only apply to the round for your school's hemisphere. After you graduate you may be eligible for both
Part-time jobs are allowed but must be approved by Outreachy organizers
You can apply more than once, but you can only be accepted once
typical_timing: Initial applications open: early February for the May-Aug round, late August for the Dec-Mar round
Initial applications due: end of February for the May-Aug round, early September for the Dec-Mar round
Contribution period opens: mid March for the May-Aug round, early October for the Dec-Mar round
Contribution period ends: mid April for the May-Aug round, end of October for the Dec-Mar round
Interns announced: mid May for the May-Aug round, late November for the Dec-Mar round
note: The current round is closed to new applicants. Any dates listed are only for people already approved.
